scenes.setting: Lady Norma arranges tomorrow's tea with her 'mysticism experts' — the Telepathist reads her recruiter's nerves and walks off in a proud straight line
scenes.text_anchor: “How about we have our afternoon tea together tomorrow?”

scenes.text_anchor: “There might be an even more ferocious guy hiding behind the killer's back.
